splits.note: Start wide, sight every six strokes
Long run in from the beach
HR 152-158. In the bars. Do not chase Bertinoro.

sessions.title: Easy swim 2 km
sessions.detail: Relaxed. Nothing hard.

sessions.title: Long ride ~150 km
sessions.detail: Easy all day. Use the aero bars in 30-minute blocks — sit up when the neck complains.

sessions.title: Easy run 5.5 km
sessions.detail: Very relaxed.

sessions.title: Test day
sessions.detail: Sets her swim paces for the whole plan.
sets: 4 × 50 m catch-up drill, 20 sec rest after each
TEST: 400 m as fast as she can hold to the end — hard but even, not a sprint that dies

sessions.title: Easy run
sessions.detail: 40 minutes easy, RPE 4. Conversational throughout.

sessions.title: 90 min — aero introduction
sessions.detail: RPE 5. 45 minutes continuous in the bars, then sit up. Cadence 85-95.

sessions.title: Fartlek
sessions.detail: 10 min easy · 6 × (3 min at RPE 7, then 2 min easy jog) · 10 min easy

sessions.title: Gym
sessions.detail: Legs, hips, core. Short and done beats perfect and skipped.

sessions.title: Threshold
sets: 4 × 50 m — kick the first length (legs only, no arms), swim the second normally. 20 sec rest
Main set: 6 × 200 m at her test pace, 30 sec rest after each
Cool-down: 200 m easy with the pull buoy

sessions.title: Long run 16 km
sessions.detail: 13 km easy, then 3 km at 4:40/km.

sessions.title: 2:30 easy
sessions.detail: RPE 5. Two blocks of 30 min in the bars. Eat every 45 minutes.

sessions.title: Aerobic and sighting
sets: 8 × 50 m alternating — odd ones kick only, even ones catch-up drill. 20 sec rest
Main set: 600 m continuous, steady and comfortable
Then 4 × 100 m, each slightly faster than the last, 20 sec rest
Skill: 4 × 50 m sighting — eyes forward every 6 strokes, fix on one point

sessions.title: Easy run
sessions.detail: 40 minutes easy, RPE 4.

days.note: Book the bike fit this week.

sessions.title: Intervals in the bars
sessions.detail: 20 min easy · 20 × (100 sec at RPE 7-8, 60 sec easy) · 10 min easy. All in the bars.

sessions.title: Progressive 9 km
sessions.detail: 3 km at RPE 4 · 3 km at RPE 6 · 3 km at RPE 7. Each third faster.

sessions.title: Toys and technique
sets: 4 × 100 m with the pull buoy, 20 sec rest
4 × 100 m easy freestyle with nothing on — carry the paddle feeling across

sessions.title: Long run 18 km
sessions.detail: 15 km easy, then 3 km at 4:40/km.

sessions.title: 2 h bike + 20 min run
sessions.detail: 2 h ride, 90 min continuous in the bars at HR 150-156. Straight off: 20 min at 4:40/km. Practise the shoe change.

sessions.title: Technique only
sets: 8 × 50 m catch-up drill wearing fins, 20 sec rest — the fins keep her moving so the drill can be done slowly and properly
400 m easy and relaxed, thinking about the long reach
Cool-down: 200 m easy. Nothing hard today.

sessions.title: Pyramid intervals
sessions.detail: 15 min warm-up · 200 / 400 / 800 / 400 / 200 m at RPE 8, jogging the same distance between each · 10 min easy

sessions.title: 80 min easy — after the fit
sessions.detail: Do this AFTER the bike fit. RPE 4-5, all in the bars. Feel the new position, change nothing else.

sessions.title: Long run 14 km easy
sessions.detail: All easy, no finish effort. That is the point of a recovery week.

sessions.title: Threshold
sets: 6 × 50 m — catch-up drill for the first length, second length normal, starting easy and finishing fast. 20 sec rest
Main set: 8 × 150 m at her test pace, 25 sec rest

days.note: Aero helmet should be in use from this week.

sessions.title: Race-effort hour
sessions.detail: 30 min easy · 60 min continuous at HR 152-158 in the bars · 30 min easy. This is exactly the effort for 17 September.

sessions.title: 5 × 1 km at race effort
sessions.detail: 2 km easy · 5 × 1 km at 4:35/km, 90 sec jog between · 2 km easy

sessions.title: Open water
sessions.detail: Lake or sea if she can get to one, wetsuit on. Practise beach starts, sighting, and swimming straight without lane ropes.
sets: 6 × 200 m steady, eyes forward every 6 strokes

sessions.title: Long run 21 km
sessions.detail: Longest run of the plan. Steady RPE 5, last 2 km at race effort. Eat on the run.

sessions.title: Full rehearsal
sessions.detail: 1 km swim + 2:30 bike + 30 min run. Race kit, race nutrition, clock running. Time both transitions. Bike at HR 152-158 in the bars. Run 30 min at 4:40/km.

sessions.title: Race pace
sets: Main set: 3 × 600 m at the effort she intends to swim on race day — steady and repeatable, not hard. 45 sec rest

sessions.title: 90 min easy
sessions.detail: RPE 4-5, all in the bars. Legs stay fresh for Thursday.

sessions.title: 1:45 bike + 5 km run
sessions.detail: 1:45 ride with 60 min at HR 152-158 in the bars. Straight off: 5 km at 4:35/km. Fast, timed transition.

sessions.title: Long run 17 km
sessions.detail: 13 km easy, then 4 km at 4:40/km. Last quality long run.

sessions.title: Race week sharpener
sets: 4 × 200 m at race effort, 30 sec rest

days.note: Volume down 40%. Intensity stays. She will feel restless — that means it is working.

sessions.title: 4 × 1 km at race effort
sessions.detail: 2 km easy · 4 × 1 km at 4:35/km, 90 sec jog · 2 km easy

sessions.title: 75 min with sharpeners
sessions.detail: In the bars throughout. 4 × 3 min at race effort, everything else easy.

sessions.title: Easy
sets: 6 × 100 m relaxed, eyes forward every 6 strokes
Cool-down: 200 m easy. Feel good, do no work.

sessions.title: 90 min easy
sessions.detail: Last real ride. Then check the bike over: tyres, brakes, bolts, gears.

sessions.title: Activation
sets: 6 × 100 m, each a little faster, finishing at race effort. 30 sec rest

sessions.title: Activation
sessions.detail: 20 min easy with 4 × 30 sec at race effort.

days.note: Travel day. Pack: race kit, wetsuit, aero helmet, nutrition, spares, timing chip.

sessions.title: Activation + walk the transitions
sessions.detail: 20-30 min easy spin, 3 × 1 min at race effort, check every gear. Then WALK both transitions: swim exit to bike, bike in to run out. Count the racks.

sessions.title: IRONMAN 70.3 CERVIA
sessions.detail: Race day.
